title: National Aeronautics and Space Administration: Phase 56H Evidence Decision
summary: NASA OIG's current open-recommendations rail remains available, but no FY 2026 FISMA evaluation or newly scoped cyber recommendation closure is published on the selected rail. Phase 56H decision: The selected evidence state remains Partially Closed. The current rail is retained as a dated continuation check rather than a repeated closure claim.
key_findings: Highest-value missing record: FY 2026 FISMA result and recommendation-level closure.
Evidence state: Partially Closed to Partially Closed.
Continuation rule: Reopen when NASA OIG publishes the FY 2026 FISMA evaluation or recommendation-level cyber closure data with tested-system scope.
why_it_matters: The record tests a named acquisition or reopening rule while keeping adjacent context separate from exact operating, corrective-action, or closure evidence.
ftfn_relevance: Records the official rail, compatible observation, and decision at a date.
Separates evidence-state movement from entity performance, quality, readiness, or value.
evidence_limits: A live recommendation mechanism does not itself supply an annual evaluation or common tested-system and mission denominator.
FY 2026 FISMA result, tested-system coverage, incidents, recovery, service effects, and mission outcomes.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
